https://www.electronics-tutorials.ws/diode/diode_7.html

need to know maximum current draw of system.

![circuit diagram](/_sources/power/diode-diode24.gif)

zener max power rating: $P_z$
zener breakdown voltage: $V_z$
zener max current: $I_z = P_z/V_z$

source voltage: $V_s$
- open circuit voltage of solar panel

minimum series resistor
$R_s = (V_s-V_z)/I_z)$

these are the diodes I have: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BG81TXF8?ref_=ppx_hzsearch_conn_dt_b_fed_asin_title_2&th=1

```
27 Value 270pcs 1/2W Zener Diodes Assortment Kit 2.4V 2.7V 3.0V 3.3V 3.6V 3.9V 4.3V 4.7V 5.1V 5.6V 6.2V 6.8V 7.5V 8.2V 9.1V 10V 12V 13V 15V 16V 18V 20V 22V 24V 27V 30V 33V
```

From the U4B hardware manual:
```
The maximum rated input voltage of the RT9013-3.3 is 6.0V (absolute maximum rating) and
recommended maximum operating voltage 5.5V. Care must therefore be taken not to use so many
solar cells that 6.0 is exceeded. Remember that solar panels get BETTER as they get colder. In
full sunshine at altitude, -55C temperatures can increase voltages and currents by up to 20%.
```

previously I used a 5.0V regulator

power rating: 0.5 watt
breakdown voltage: 5.1 V
zener max current = 0.5 watt/5.1 V = 0.09 Amp = 90 mA
solar panel:
- max voltage (open circuit): 7.4 V
- max current 128 mA

minimum series resistor:
(7.4V - 5.1V)/90mA = 25.5 Ohm

Computing minimums

```{python}
power_rating = 0.5 # watt
breakdown_voltage = 4.7  # volt
zener_max_current = power_rating/breakdown_voltage
solar_max_voltage = 7.4 # volt open circuit
series_resistor_min = (solar_max_voltage - breakdown_voltage)/ zener_max_current
resistor_power = series_resistor_min * zener_max_current**2
print(f"Minimum series resistor: {series_resistor_min} Ohm")
print(f"Zener max current:       {zener_max_current} Amp")
print(f"Resistor power:          {resistor_power} Watt")
```

Computing real scenario

```{python}
power_rating = 0.5 # watt
breakdown_voltage = 4.7  # volt
zener_max_current = power_rating/breakdown_voltage
solar_max_voltage = 7.4 # volt open circuit
series_resistor_min = (solar_max_voltage - breakdown_voltage)/ zener_max_current
series_resistor_select = 33 # series_resistor_min #27 #68 # Ohm
zener_current = (solar_max_voltage - breakdown_voltage)/series_resistor_select
resistor_power = series_resistor_select * zener_max_current**2
print(f"Minimum series resistor: {series_resistor_min} Ohm")
print(f"Selected resistor:       {series_resistor_select} Ohm")
print(f"Zener max current:       {zener_max_current} Amp")
print(f"Zener current select:    {zener_current} Amp")
print(f"Resistor power:          {resistor_power} Watt")

```
